tokens.name: surface-app
tokens.usage: Window and screen background: iOS grouped background, macOS window background. Content cards sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, inset grouped list sections, table bodies and control fills that must read against surface-app.

tokens.name: surface-well
tokens.usage: Recessed fills: segmented-control track, search field, text field fill on iOS, skeleton bars.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, alerts and sheets that sit above content. Dark mode lifts it instead of casting a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-tooltip
tokens.usage: Mac help tags (.help) only. Text on it is text-on-tooltip.

tokens.name: surface-thumb
tokens.usage: The selected segment's thumb resting on surface-well.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Pointer hover on iPad and Mac rows and plain buttons. Never used on iPhone.

tokens.name: bg-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state for rows and plain buttons on every platform.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles and body copy on surface-app, surface-card and surface-raised. 15:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Subtitles, row detail text and field labels on every surface. At least 4.5:1 on surface-app in both themes.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Footnotes, section footers and timestamps on surface-card (4.8:1 light). Source pair flagged: 4.2:1 on surface-app in light, so on the bare background use it only at 15px+ or switch to text-secondary.

tokens.name: text-placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text in empty fields only; never for content. Decorative contrast by design (below 4.5:1).

tokens.name: text-on-tooltip
tokens.usage: Text on surface-tooltip.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The app tint: filled buttons, selected controls, switch on-track, progress fill, selection checkmarks. One accent per screen.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Filled button under the iPad/Mac pointer.

tokens.name: accent-active
tokens.usage: Filled button while pressed.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted button fill, selected sidebar row, selected list row background.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Labels and glyphs on accent and accent-hover fills.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Accent used as text: links, plain buttons, nav bar buttons, selected sidebar label. 4.5:1 on surface-card and accent-soft.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Hairlines inside a card: list row separators on surface-card, dividers between grouped controls.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Outer border of cards, bordered buttons, fields and tables. Separators on surface-app.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Switch off-track, bordered button under pointer, stronger dividers.

tokens.name: border-interactive
tokens.usage: Checkbox and radio outlines on Mac; field border under the pointer.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Apple addition: resting outline of a control that has no other visible edge, such as one-time-code boxes on glass. 3:1 or better on surface-card, surface-app, surface-raised and surface-well in both themes.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Field border while editing (iOS) or key focus (Mac).

tokens.name: neutral-solid
tokens.usage: Solid fill for a neutral button or count badge.

tokens.name: neutral-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Neutral solid fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: neutral-solid-active
tokens.usage: Neutral solid fill while pressed.

tokens.name: neutral-solid-strong
tokens.usage: Neutral fill that carries white text in both themes, such as a swipe action. neutral-solid turns light in dark mode.

tokens.name: neutral-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on the neutral solid fill.

tokens.name: neutral-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of neutral callouts, tags and subtle badges.

tokens.name: neutral-text-on-subtle
tokens.usage: Text on neutral-bg-subtle. At least 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: neutral-text
tokens.usage: Neutral text and glyphs on surface-card and surface-app: validation messages, status labels.

tokens.name: neutral-border
tokens.usage: Border of neutral callouts and tags.

tokens.name: success-solid

tokens.name: success-solid-hover
tokens.usage: Success solid fill under the pointer.

tokens.name: success-solid-active
tokens.usage: Success solid fill while pressed.

tokens.name: success-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on the success solid fill.

tokens.name: success-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of success callouts, tags and subtle badges.

tokens.name: success-text-on-subtle
tokens.usage: Text on success-bg-subtle. At least 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success glyphs and 3:1 marks (checkmarks, status dots) on surface-card. Source pair flagged: 3.3:1 in light, below 4.5:1 for text; set success copy in success-text-on-subtle on success-bg-subtle or pair the glyph with text-secondary words.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Border of success callouts and tags.

tokens.name: warning-solid

tokens.name: warning-solid-hover

tokens.name: warning-solid-active

tokens.name: warning-solid-strong
tokens.usage: Warning fill that carries white text, such as a swipe action. warning-solid is too light for text.

tokens.name: warning-on-solid
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on the warning solid fill.

tokens.name: warning-bg-subtle
tokens.usage: Background of warning callouts, tags and subtle badges.

tokens.name: warning-text-on-subtle
tokens.usage: Text on warning-bg-subtle. At least 4.5:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning glyphs and 3:1 marks on surface-card. Source pair flagged: 3.2:1 in light, below 4.5:1 for text; set warning copy in warning-text-on-subtle on warning-bg-subtle.

tokens.name: warning-border
tokens.usage: Border of warning callouts and tags.

tokens.name: danger-solid-hover

tokens.name: danger-solid-active

tokens.name: danger-on-solid

tokens.name: danger-bg-subtle

tokens.name: danger-text-on-subtle

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Border of destructive callouts and tags.

tokens.usage: Apple addition: destructive labels on light surfaces and glass (Delete in menus, alerts, swipe-free rows, validation messages). 6.5:1 on surface-card in light; danger-text stays for glyphs and 3:1 marks.

tokens.name: fill-track

tokens.name: info-border

tokens.name: chart-neutral

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring on iPad (hardware keyboard) and Mac. Solid, 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: focus-field-ring
tokens.usage: Soft halo around a focused text field, outside its focus-ring border.

tokens.name: focus-field-ring-error
tokens.usage: Soft halo around a focused text field that has an error.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimming behind alerts and modal sheets on iPhone and iPad. Mac sheets do not dim.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Regular Liquid Glass for the navigation layer in previews: bar buttons, tab bar, toolbars, sidebars, partial sheets. Apps use the system material (.glassEffect()), never this colour.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: Rim of glass shapes in previews; reads as the lens edge.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: Outer hairline that separates glass from the content beneath it.

tokens.name: glass-tint
tokens.usage: Tinted glass for the one prominent action on a bar (.glassProminent): Done, Verify, New. Label is on-accent.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Denser regular glass for panels that carry reading text: menus, popovers, alerts, confirmation dialogs, the command palette. Keeps text-primary above 4.5:1 over any content.

tokens.name: glass-fill-clear
tokens.usage: Clear glass, only over media (covers, photos, charts drawn full-bleed). Always paired with glass-dim and on-accent-white glyphs.

tokens.name: glass-dim
tokens.usage: Dimming layer under clear glass so its glyphs stay legible on bright media.

tokens.name: glass-specular
tokens.usage: Top-edge specular highlight of glass in previews; the system draws this from the device's motion.

tokens.name: glass-tint-soft
tokens.usage: Selected item inside a glass bar: the tab bar pill, the active glass segment.

tokens.name: glass-sheen
tokens.usage: Top-down sheen across glass in previews: the light the lens catches.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: Bright corner of the glass rim in previews (top-leading edge).

tokens.name: glass-rim-soft
tokens.usage: Dim corner of the glass rim in previews (bottom-trailing edge).

tokens.name: selection-row
tokens.usage: Selected row in a focused Mac table or sidebar. Label switches to on-accent.

tokens.usage: Gap between a row title and its subtitle.

tokens.usage: Row horizontal padding on Mac; gap between a symbol and its row title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: iPhone screen margin and inset grouped list padding; card padding on Mac.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Mac checkboxes, small tags, keyboard-shortcut keycaps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Mac buttons, fields and segmented controls (Shadow default control radius).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Mac cards, popovers, menus; iOS small tiles and avatars in squircle mode.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: iOS text fields, search fields and stepper; Mac sheets, alerts and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Mac windows' content cards and inspector panels; iOS menus and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-section
tokens.usage: Apple addition: iOS and iPadOS inset grouped list sections and content cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel

tokens.name: radius-sheet

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: every iOS and iPadOS button, tags, badges, switches, the tab bar, toolbar groups.

tokens.name: shadow-e1

tokens.name: shadow-e2

tokens.name: shadow-e3
tokens.usage: Popovers, alerts, Mac sheets and the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every floating glass shape. Apple addition: glass keeps its shadow in dark mode so it separates from content.
